editorial.standfirst: A representative private Draft envelope for the Bembridge Guide import workflow.
editorial.introduction: Bembridge Harbour is approached from the eastern Isle of Wight and requires current local navigation information before a visit.

sections.heading: Before arrival
body: Use current official harbour guidance, charts, notices and forecasts when planning an approach. This regression fixture deliberately leaves safety-critical details unresolved so that the record can be imported as a private Draft but cannot pass publication review automatically. The fixture represents the shape produced for a practical marina Guide, including structured region, editorial, navigation, facilities, contacts, search metadata and verification fields. Editors must check every operational detail against authoritative sources before publication.

practicalNotes: Confirm access and local conditions with the harbour before departure.

warnings.text: Approach information must be verified against current official sources.

approach: Consult current harbour directions and charted information.
hazards: Do not rely on this Draft fixture for navigation.

seo.metaDescription: A private Bembridge Harbour Guide Draft awaiting editorial and safety verification.

verification.notes: Representative regression data only; navigation and facilities require editorial verification.

unresolved.reason: Current official approach details must be checked by an editor.
